description: I'm Tiago, Information Systems undergrad at IF Goiano with skills in Web Dev, 3D/WebXR, and Figma. We're tackling "The Earth Information Jukebox" to turn NASA Earth imagery into real-time music and accessible soundscapes. Join us! We have a clear MVP plan ready to build. Looking for teammates interested in Frontend/UI, Audio/Music, NASA Data/Storytelling, or Pitch/Video.
